column8: ∀ (m : ℕ) (u v : Minidregg.Theory.binaryTower m), Minidregg.Theory.bTrace m (u + v) = Minidregg.Theory.bTrace m u + Minidregg.Theory.bTrace m v
∀ (m : ℕ) (a : Minidregg.Theory.binaryTower m), Minidregg.Theory.bTrace (m + 1) ((Minidregg.Theory.binaryTowerEmbed m) a) = 0
∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Minidregg.Theory.binaryTower m), Minidregg.Theory.bTrace m u = 0 ∨ Minidregg.Theory.bTrace m u = 1
∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Minidregg.Theory.binaryTower m), Minidregg.Theory.bTrace m u ^ 2 = Minidregg.Theory.bTrace m u
∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Minidregg.Theory.binaryTower m), Minidregg.Theory.bTrace m (u ^ 2) = Minidregg.Theory.bTrace m u
∀ (m : ℕ) (y : Minidregg.Theory.binaryTower (m + 1)), Minidregg.Theory.bTrace (m + 1) y = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (2 ^ m), (y + y ^ 2 ^ 2 ^ m) ^ 2 ^ i
∀ {m : ℕ} {y : Minidregg.Theory.binaryTower (m + 1)}, y ^ 2 ^ 2 ^ m = y → y ∈ (Minidregg.Theory.binaryTowerEmbed m).range
∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Minidregg.Theory.binaryTower m), u ^ 2 ^ 2 ^ m = u
